name: death dog
desc: Death Dog is a CR 1 monstrosity.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save activity=7RkSJfzdID9Ccqmn]] saving throw against disease or become &Reference[poisoned] until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: two-headed
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being &reference[blinded apply=false], &reference[charmed apply=false], &reference[deafened apply=false], &reference[frightened apply=false], &reference[stunned apply=false], and knocked &reference[unconscious apply=false].
